content: Obubî bwabonekana hoshi
Muyumve akanwa ka Nyamuzinda, bene Israheli, bulya Nyamuzinda ali lubanja haguma n’abantu b’ecihugo. Omu cihugo, murhaciri mwîkubagirwa, ntà buzigire, ntà kucimanya na kukenga Nyamuzinda.
Ci birha n’obunywesi, kunigana n’enshombo, bugonyi n’obulyâlya, kuyîrhana ene n’irhondo.
Na ntyo ecihugo ciri omu mishîbo, n’abantu bamwo boshi bahosire, ciru n’ensimba z’emuzirhu n’enyunyi z’oku nkuba, ciru n’enfî z’omu nyanja ziherêrekîre. Obulyâlya bw’abadâhwa
Ci kwône ntâye wajàga lubanja, ntâye wasambaga. We mudâhwa we nshimbire.
Ohirimire mâshi, ohirimire budufu, n’omulêbi ahirimire haguma nâwe, na ntyo nkola nâyîrha nyoko.
Olubaga lwâni lufirire okubula obumanye. Bulya w’oyo wakabulire obumanye, nkolaga nakukaga omu budâhwa bwâni; wayibagîre e­ nyigîrizo za Nyamuzinda wâwe nkolaga nayibagira abâna bâwe.
Boshi oku banali banjirîre ebyâha, irenge lyâbo nâlihindula nshonyi.
Ebyâha by’olubaga lwâni bwo bwigusi bwâbo, n’amabî gâlwo go bahà­rhira.
Ci omudâhwa naye nâmujira kuguma n’olubaga; nâmuhanira olugendo lwâge, nâmulyuza ebijiro byâge.
Bâlya, ci barhâyigurhe, bâjira obubaraga ci barhaburhe bâna; bulya balesire Nyakasane bacîhira omu by’enshonyi. Enterekêro ya Israheli eri nterekêro ya banyamuzinda bw’obwîhambi
Obugonyi n’amamvu irhwe biheza.
Olubaga lwâni lunagendilaguza emw’enshushano y’omurhi. Cihimbi ca karhi cilufulûlira emyanzi, bulya omurhima gw’obubaraga gwabahabwîre, balesire Nyamuzinda wâbo bashimba obubaraga.

Oku busôngerwe bw’entondo kwo barherekêrera, oku rhurhondo kwo bayôkera entûlo zâbo, idako ly’emirhi y’emishebeye, emitudu, n’enterebinta, mpu ho hali ecîhôho. Co cirhumire, akabà bâli binyu ziri mbaraga, akabà bâlikazi binyu bali bagonyi,
Ntâhane bâli binyu oku bubaraga bwâbo, ntâhane bâlikazi binyu oku bugonyi bwâbo, bulya nabo bônene eburhambi bacîyegiìlire n’e­mbaraga, barherekêre haguma n’entazi.
Yûda na Israheli barhondwa
Akabà oli mbaraga, wâni Israheli, Yûda yêhe amanyage obubî. Mu­rhajâga e Gilgali, murhasôkeraga e Bet-Avena
, murhacigashaga, mpu: «mbotumirha Nyamuzinda».
Bulya Israheli aciyêrekîne nka cigamba, kurhi Nyamuzinda akacimuyâbulira nka mwâna-buzi omu bulambo bugali?
Efrayimu anywanîne n’abazimu, omuleke.
Ngasi hali endalwè ho balâla, barhishi n’oburhali bubaraga, abarhambo bâbo, enshonyi lyo irenge lyâbo.
Empûsi yabakurubukana omu byûbi byâyo, enshonyi zâbabumbira aha mpêro zâbo.

footnotes.text: 4, 15 Bet-Avena: nyumpa ya bubî: câha. Lir’izîno lya kugayaguza Beteli; n’obwo Beteli eri nyumpa ya Nyamuzinda.
